An assembly job with lots of variety, great colleagues and work you can be proud of. That’s what you’ll find at DKG in Bergen op Zoom! Plus, you get an awesome salary of €17,24! 🤑 This job as a production worker assembly is one of a kind! Ready to join the team?! 🚀

What we offer
- Salary of €17,24 per hour (incl shift allowances)
- Worked 500 hours? Means a salary increase!
- A lot of career opportunities
- Chance on a fixed contract
- Travel allowances of €0,23 per kilometer
- Great colleagues to work with!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You are available for 3 to 5 days;
- You are available for at least 2 shifts;
- You have your own transport to get to Bergen op Zoom;
- You already live in or around Bergen op Zoom.

What will you do
You’ll work on the assembly line where kitchen cabinets come to life! Big ones, small ones.. All shapes and sizes! You make sure the right drawers fit perfectly into the right cabinet. Also you’ll mount the back panels into the cabinet! Don’t worry, the screens show you exactly what to do. It’s like a giant construction kit! No technical experience needed. We’ll teach you everything you need to know! 🚀

As a production worker you work in 2 shifts. An early shift from 06:00h to 14:15h and a late shift from 14:10h to 22:30h.

And just imagine. The cabinets you’ve assembled today could be standing in someone’s kitchen next week. How cool is that! 🤩

Where will you work
You’ll join DKG, the kitchen factory, in Bergen op Zoom as a production worker. The nicest kitchens are made here! From simple wooden planks to complete kitchen cabinets. Together with your colleagues you create high-quality kitchens for everyone! 🤩

At DKG, everyone knows each other. In Dutch we say “ons kent ons”! The vibe here is friendly and  welcoming. You’ll feel right at home from day one. From ice creams on hot days to food and drink

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery Courier!
Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 
What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.
 
Your main tasks include:
 
- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to €19,49 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040.
Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.
What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:
•            You are at least 16 years old
•            You live in the Netherlands
•            You speak either Dutch or English
•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection
•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

 Please note: delivery using a car, e-step (electric scooter), or any other vehicle is not allowed
